models_evaluated: 24 MLLMs from InternVL, Qwen, and DeepSeek families

links.outcome: Zero-shot MLLM accuracy on ophthalmic disease screening, staging, and anatomical recognition benchmarks
links.effect: Qwen-7B and InternVL reached 58.26% and 57.83% accuracy in zero-shot disease screening; disease staging performance often close to random baselines.
links.quote: Nonetheless, overall performance remained suboptimal and often close to random baselines for challenging tasks such as disease staging, underscoring the substantial gap between general-domain MLLMs and the specialized requirements of ophthalmology.

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks multimodal large language models on LMOD+, a dataset and benchmark for ophthalmic imaging tasks, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
